describe.credit: The boards and mounts are {author}'s designs on MakerWorld ({url}); this model is the plan, not their files.
describe.summary: {boards} filling {size} of wall, {across} across × {down} down, for a {printer}. {layout} layout, held by {system} {mm} mm off the wall.
error.noFit: No run of boards fits this wall on that bed.
form.bedTooSmall: none — the bed is too small
form.printerHelp: The bed decides the biggest board you can print: a board is 20 mm per hole plus 20, so a 256 mm bed takes 11 holes, or 240 mm.
form.spaceHelp: The space you want covered, not the boards. The planner fills as much of it as whole boards can.
layout.balanced.summary: The fewest boards, sizes kept even, and as few mirrored as it can manage.
layout.gap.summary: The fewest boards, leaving up to the gap you allow uncovered.
layout.largest.summary: The biggest boards that fit the bed, with one smaller board left over.
layout.no-mirror.summary: Odd-hole boards only, so no file has to be flipped before slicing.
layout.uniform.summary: Every board identical, which may leave a strip of the wall open.
list.credit: Everything printed here is {author}'s design. This plan says which of their files to print and how many; the files themselves come from MakerWorld under their licence.
list.mirroring.1: A board with an even number of holes has to be flipped for its pattern to carry on into its neighbour,
list.mirroring.2: so every other one of them is mirrored. In Bambu Studio or Orca: right-click the object, Mirror, then
list.mirroring.3: the axis named above. The counts above say how many to print each way round.
list.notPublished: NOT PUBLISHED IN THIS SIZE — change the wall or the layout
list.plannedWith: Planned with the Skadis planner in Thingport.
list.printOneFirst: Print one board first and offer it up to the wall before committing to the rest.
part.m4-wall-screw-30-mm-or-longer: M4 wall screw, 30 mm or longer
plan.credit: Boards and mounts by {author} on MakerWorld. This plans which of their files to print; the files come into your library with the tool.
plan.flipNote: This board isn't symmetric, so every other one is flipped
plan.leftOver: {across} mm across and {down} mm down left over
plan.notPublished: No file is published in this size.
plans.empty: Nothing saved yet. “Save the plan” keeps the wall you’re on.
plans.kept: Kept in the tool, for you
plans.openBody: The plan is in your library, with the print order in its notes.
plans.savedInTool: The plan is saved in the tool
save.note: One model with a plate for every part, in print order, each at its true size — a picture of the plan is its cover and the print order is in its notes. The parts themselves stay where they came from: these plates are the plan, not AU3D's files.
save.title: Save the plan to your library
system.spacers.summary: A spacer and a screw at each board corner.
system.wall-mounts.summary: One printed mount wherever board corners meet.
view.canvas: The wall seen from the front: drag to move it, scroll to zoom
view.fitAria: Fit the wall in the view
